items.excerpt: Suno confirms its v6 model was trained on user-generated interactions, as Sony and UMG sue again just nine days after launch, calling v6 'the fruit of the same poisoned tree'.
Sony and UMG's latest lawsuit against Suno accuses the company of 'model laundering' by training v6 on outputs of earlier, allegedly infringing models.
Music AI is splitting into two industries: transient, synthetic content versus lasting, artist-driven music built on identity.
The San Jose Sharks replaced their goal song after only a season when fans discovered it had been generated with Suno.
Fred again.. spoke out against AI-generated music in a series of Instagram stories, arguing 'the process is the magic' of making music.
Spotify is the first streaming service connected to Meta's Muse AI agent: listeners can ask Muse to play audio, save songs and build Spotify playlists conversationally.
Sony Music Group becomes the first music company to join ARIAM, the Alliance for Responsible Innovation in the Arts & Media, alongside Disney, the BBC and The New York Times.

Melofty's Axom Max is a modeler/guitar synth whose AI Rig Assistant builds full pedal-amp-IR signal chains from a text or voice prompt like '80s British stadium rock', plus a DeepSynth pickup-free guitar synth.
A Suno-made song by YouTube creator Joseon HipHop reached Melon's Top 100, exposing Korea's regulatory vacuum after KOMCA withdrew its AI-assisted registration rules within 22 days.
How blind musicians prepare scores via Braille music, and where AI note recognition, score conversion and AI vocal rehearsal tracks could help.
